details:
0G Clinic is a web-based astronaut health monitoring and psychological support system designed for long-duration space missions. The project integrates physical health tracking, symptom assessment, emotional check-ins, and daily routine management into one platform. Its main purpose is to help astronauts monitor their overall health and recognize potential problems in microgravity environments.

The system is divided into several modules. The Cardiorespiratory Module monitors blood pressure, heart rate, oxygen saturation (SpO2), respiratory rate, core body temperature, and blood coagulation indicators. The Neuro-Sensory Module tracks intraocular pressure, sleep duration, reaction time, and stress indicators. The Musculoskeletal Module monitors daily physical activity and radiation exposure, helping astronauts pay attention to muscle and bone health.

The website also includes a clinical questionnaire containing questions about vision, dizziness, muscle weakness, sleep disturbances, concentration, stress, loneliness, and crew communication. Based on astronauts' answers, it provides relevant recommendations and allows additional questions to be created. Its psychological support module offers emotional check-ins, guided breathing exercises, relaxation techniques, and personalized activities to help astronauts manage isolation and stress.

Another important component is the Alarms and Protocol Timers system, which organizes reminders for hydration, meals, medication, sleep, rest, and exercise. The astronaut profile stores personal and mission information, while the dashboard displays vital signs, ECG visualization, health indicators, and historical averages.

The platform uses configurable thresholds to classify entered measurements as normal or abnormal and provides visual alerts when readings fall outside their limits. It also includes settings import/export and browser-based profile storage. The current interface supports manual data entry and simulated readings; connecting actual medical sensors would be a separate development stage.

The project addresses an important challenge in space exploration: maintaining astronauts' physical and psychological health simultaneously. By combining health monitoring, symptom assessment, daily activity management, and mental well-being support, 0G Clinic aims to provide a unified digital environment for astronaut healthcare during space missions.
